instructions.instruction: Push the four office chairs under the desks in order. After each push, stow both hands and retreat straight back, then crab sideways behind the next chair while continuing to face the desks. Finish with all four chairs tucked in and both arms stowed.
instructions.instruction_zh: 依次把四把办公椅推入桌下。每把推好后收回双手并直线后退，保持面朝桌子，横向蟹行到下一把椅子后方再继续推，全部归位后收臂停稳。
